summary: Iteration 7 — full backend + frontend testing of the NEW auth layer (register/login/me + Bearer JWT), per-user analytics isolation, /api/jobs/recommend two-bucket recommendations, JobMatches UI on /analyze, Sign-in/Sign-up pages, ProtectedRoute redirect, Navigation logout, landing-page stats removal, and the camera-permission suppress fix. All 21/21 backend pytest cases PASS (11 new auth+jobs + 10 regression). Frontend: login, signup, logout, protected route, /analyze → Show me matches with 5 current + 5 stretch jobs and all four apply links (Naukri/LinkedIn/Indeed/Unstop) verified end-to-end against live LLM. Landing page stats section (95%/10K+/50K+) confirmed REMOVED. Camera-suppress code path verified by static inspection — triggerWarning early-returns while Date.now() < suppressBlurUntilRef.current (8s after enableCamera, 6s after startAudioRecording).

minor.issue: No auth required — anyone (anonymous or authenticated) can invoke an expensive LLM call. Spec didn't require auth gating but it would be sensible rate-limit/auth-gate this in the future.

issues: The JobMatches card uses a light/white background while everything above it (Improvement Suggestions, ATS score) is dark-purple gradient. Visual break between dark sections and the light job cards. Recommend aligning JobMatches with the same bg-slate-800/60 + text-white dark palette used on /results and the improvement panel.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py — file is now 1037 lines. Approaching the 700-line soft-cap; the new /jobs/recommend block could move to its own router module along with the cheating endpoints.
/app/backend/auth.py — _verify_password catches bare Exception (line 71). Fine for brittleness but consider logging the bcrypt error to aid debugging future hash-format issues.

/app/backend/auth.py — google-session cookie uses samesite=none + secure=true which is correct for cross-site preview hosts. Confirm production deploys over HTTPS, otherwise the cookie will not be set.
/app/backend/server.py — /jobs/recommend has no rate limiting; an anonymous caller can repeatedly trigger 30-90s LLM calls. Consider auth-gating or per-IP throttling.

/app/frontend/src/components/JobMatches.jsx — Uses light/white surface while neighbouring panels are dark purple. Visual inconsistency on /analyze. Suggest applying the bg-slate-800/60 + text-white classes used on /results.

/app/frontend/src/pages/InterviewRoomWithVideo.jsx — 752 lines; same > 700-line concern. Camera/audio suppression is correct but the file mixes proctoring, recording, evaluation, and UI; consider splitting hooks (useCheatingDetection, useVideoRecording).

/app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx — When mounted, the token is read from localStorage and an Authorization header is attached to the global axios default. Confirm there is no race between the initial /auth/me probe and the first protected-page render (ProtectedRoute should wait on a loading flag, which it does — verified by the 1-second redirect-after-localStorage-clear test).
